hint.lead_low: Lead low and keep your strong cards for later
hint.play_luette: Play a luette to take the trick
hint.partner_winning: Your partner is winning, so do not spend a strong card
hint.follow_low: You cannot win this trick, so throw a low card

tutorial.info: Mene, trick and team scores appear here. Opposite seats are fixed partners in a 2v2 game and you sit at seat 0. There is no bidding and no discard.
tutorial.luettes: This is the heart of the game. **Strength is per card, not per rank.** The 3 of diamonds (Monsieur) is the best card in the deck while the 3 of spades is ordinary. These six cards occupy the whole top of the ladder.
tutorial.trick: Cards played into the current trick appear here. **There is no trump suit and no follow obligation** — any card is always legal. When equal ranks meet, the card played **first** wins.
tutorial.hand: Your hand: 5 cards out of 48. Any luette you hold is named above your hand — the card art alone does not tell you it is the strongest card in the deck.
tutorial.actions: A mene is 5 tricks and **taking 3 of them scores 1 point**. You do not need all five. Throw your weakest card on tricks you cannot win and keep the luettes for when they decide one.
